description: This platform’s oil price and production strategy model: Brent today, the model’s monthly path for the next 24 months under current Saudi and OPEC+ policy (anchored to the EIA outlook and the futures strip, with the unanchored structural path beside it) with a Monte Carlo fan (P10–P90), the OECD stocks and balance behind it, the EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook and the WTI futures strip as benchmarks, World Bank and IMF price assumptions, the inventory–price calibration with its fit statistics, and what changed since the previous EIA outlook. Modelled scenario analysis, not a forecast.
name: oil_outlook
title: Oil price outlook
